inquiry: 2023 Figure 1 dark-green municipal waters are outside the narrower Visayan Sea domain; determine whether they belong to the selected baseline model.
decision: The selected baseline explicitly includes the commercial waters and both domain and non-domain municipal waters of all 33 coastal municipalities/cities. The 2023 outer municipal/commercial extent remains the supported model extent. The 2026 map is indicative, and its narrower dashed lines do not override the baseline methods.

2023_source.exact_passage:
The Visayan Sea is located in the central Philippine archipelago
(11.4328° N, 123.5280° E) with a total surface area of approximately
12,521.8 km2 and 16,728.5 km2 if municipal waters outside the
Visayan Sea domain are included, respectively (Figure 1). For the
purpose of this study, the Visayan Sea baseline Ecopath model
includes the delineated commercial water area and municipal
waters (both domain and non-domain) of all 33 coastal
municipalities and cities that surround the Visayan Sea. Due to a
lack of information on the spatial distributional patterns of ﬁshing
effort, ﬁsheries activities are hereby initially assumed to occur
throughout the entire extent of the delineated model area.

2026_source.exact_reuse_passage:
This study made use of the Visayan Sea baseline ecosystem model
(Bacalso et al., 2023b), which was constructed using the Ecopath with
Ecosim (EwE) v6.6 tool (Christensen et al., 2008).
2026_source.figure_caption: Location and indicative area of the Visayan Sea (black dashed lines) as applied in this study.
